doc.title: Laurence Juber interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Closing remarks and goodbyes
summary: They hope live music returns soon and say their thanks and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview

blocks.x: Well we hope it comes back as soon as possible, and I have a feeling that all of us who miss it so badly, that first gig is just going to be like terrific. You get that heart started.
Thank you very much for your time.
Oh you’re very welcome, and I enjoyed the conversation, and anytime.
